meta.name: incoming-request-advisor
meta.description: Decode an incoming message into a structured breakdown that separates the literal ask from the job-to-be-done. Use before replying to a loaded Slack ping, email, mandate, or escalation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将模糊请求拆解为清晰任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常收到含糊的指令或紧急消息需要快速理清重点。
copy.tagline_en: Decode vague requests into clear tasks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often receive ambiguous instructions or urgent messages and need to quickly identify the core ask.

howto.what: 会把收到的消息拆成一份结构化分析,列出消息类型、发件人身份与关系、字面请求与背后的真正目标、成功标准、风险和下一步建议;推断内容会单独标注为待验证假设。
howto.when: 当用户贴入一条待回复的消息(Slack 私信、邮件、上级指令或升级投诉等)并希望先解析再回复时触发。

say.text: 我 VP 刚问仪表盘改版能不能进下个迭代,帮我分析这条。
say.note: 会输出拆解,并建议怎么回。

say.text: 收到一封客户成功负责人的长邮件,先拆解再决定怎么回。
say.note: 解析发件人立场与真实目标。

say.text: 一位高管发来指令,听起来像排期,先找出背后要的结果。
say.note: 区分字面要求与真正目的。

howto.what_en: It turns the incoming message into a structured breakdown: message type, sender relationship, literal ask vs. underlying goal, success criteria, risks, and next steps; anything inferred is listed separately as assumptions to validate.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user pastes an incoming message (Slack DM, email, mandate, escalation, etc.) and wants it analyzed before replying.

say_en.text: VP asked if the redesign can hit next sprint. Analyze before I reply.
say_en.note: Returns the breakdown and a suggested reply.

say_en.text: I got a long escalation email from a customer-success lead. Break it down first.
say_en.note: Reads sender power and underlying goal.

say_en.text: A senior mandate sounds like a build order. Find the job to be done.
say_en.note: Separates literal ask from intended outcome.
